offers_products.reason: Sells freight transportation and logistics services; trucks and containers are tools, not products sold.

offers_services.reason: Intermodal, dedicated trucking, truckload, LTL, last-mile delivery and freight brokerage via J.B. Hunt 360 platform.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are shippers and businesses; last-mile delivery to homes is on behalf of business customers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Shippers of all sizes, including global supply chains, wholesale distributors and manufacturers, buy its freight services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Shippers repeatedly move freight under dedicated contracts and ongoing intermodal and truckload relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Freight volumes fall in downturns, and shippers can cut or reroute shipments and shift to cheaper modes.

big_ticket.reason: Individual shipments and loads are small, frequent, routine purchases for shippers.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from its trucks, containers, rail partnerships and technology platform, not just staff time.

large_customers.reason: Intermodal and dedicated contract customers are mostly large enterprise shippers, though small businesses are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns large fleets of tractors, trailers and intermodal containers needing ongoing capital investment.
